children.design_delta_summary: 1) Replace vague provisional prose with a two-surface conformance bundle that separates protocol-boundary app claims from host/runtime embodiment claims. 2) Require a minimum auditable evidence packet for any partial-conformance or first-port claim: feature matrix, dependency ledger, and local observation/failure records. 3) Add explicit negative-promise wording so hashes, live channels, local IDs, and host-driver effects are not mistaken for capabilities, durability, or kernel obligations.

1) Split the teachable first-port target into a small core runtime surface plus separate app capability profiles. 2) Add a concrete provisional conformance claim card template with explicit boundary identity, omitted obligations, dependency disclosure, and promise splits. 3) Put non-idempotent device replay handling in a profile-level crash-safe effect ledger rather than the core port.
